From Wonder of U · Price: it only hits creatures that pursue you, and its power grows slowly.

Theme Fate

  • 1: A creature that moves toward you, targets you or Seeks you takes @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] from a minor accident (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}), once per round.
  • 5: A creature that fails is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until its next turn.
  • 9: Surge: a creature pursuing you takes @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage from a major accident.
  • 13: Allies are never targeted.
  • 17: A critical failure also leaves the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
